title: Algebraic Expressions
description: Class 7 IMO — Algebraic expressions: terms, coefficients, like and unlike terms, addition and subtraction of expressions, multiplication of a monomial, and finding the value of an expression.

topics.title: Terms, Coefficients & Like Terms
topics.concept:
Like terms have the same variable raised to the same power. Constants (plain numbers) are also like terms with each other.

ExpressionLike TermsUnlike Terms
4x + 2x4x and 2x (same variable)—
3x + 2y—3x and 2y (different variables)
5x^2 + 3x—5x^2 and 3x (different powers)

Rules for combining like terms:

  • Add or subtract the coefficients only
  • The variable part stays unchanged
  • Always carry the sign (+ or -) with each term
LIKE TERMS SORTING:

Expression: 4x + 2y - x + 3y

Step 1: Group like terms
  x-terms: 4x and -x
  y-terms: 2y and 3y

Step 2: Combine
  (4x - x) = 3x
  (2y + 3y) = 5y

Final Answer: 3x + 5y

examples.problem: In the term 5x, what is the coefficient?
Are 3x and 7x like or unlike terms?
examples.solution: Like terms — same variable part x.

recap: Coefficient = the number multiplying the variable.
Like terms have the same variable part.
Only like terms (same variable AND same exponent) can be combined
Add or subtract only the coefficients
The variable part does not change when combining
Always carry the sign with each term

topics.title: Adding & Subtracting Expressions
topics.concept: To add or subtract expressions, combine like terms only. So 3x + 5x = 8x and 7a − 3a = 4a. Unlike terms cannot be combined.
recap: Add or subtract only like terms.

topics.title: Multiplication & Value of an Expression
topics.concept:
Distributive Property: Multiply a number outside parentheses by each term inside.

a(b + c) = ab + ac

Factoring is the reverse of the distributive property — find the Greatest Common Factor (GCF) and pull it out.

ab + ac = a(b + c)

To factor, ask: what is the largest number/variable that divides all terms evenly?

DISTRIBUTIVE PROPERTY:

    3(2x + 5)
         |
    [split here]
    /          \
  3 x 2x  +  3 x 5
    |              |
   6x         +   15

Answer: 6x + 15

FACTORING (reverse):
  8x + 12
  GCF(8,12) = 4
  = 4(2x + 3)

examples.solution: GCF of 8 and 12 is 4. Factor out 4: 4(2x + 3). Check: 4 x 2x = 8x and 4 x 3 = 12.

recap: Multiply a monomial into each term of the bracket.
Find the value by substituting for the variable.
Distribute to EVERY term inside the parentheses
Factoring = finding GCF and writing as a product
Check your factoring by distributing back
GCF must divide both the coefficient and the variable part
